parameters.query:
SELECT c.code AS client_code, j.id AS job_id, j.client_id, j.unique_key, j.payload_json, j.priority
FROM claim_next_job('wf04', 900, 'ENGINE_OBSERVATION') j
LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = j.client_id
WHERE j.id IS NOT NULL

SELECT q.query_text, q.language, q.region,
       e.canonical_name,
       COALESCE(e.aliases, '[]'::jsonb) AS aliases,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.claim_text) FROM claims c
                 WHERE c.entity_id = e.id AND c.verification = 'VERIFIED'),
                '[]'::jsonb) AS verified_claims
FROM queries q
LEFT JOIN intents i ON i.id = q.intent_id
LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = i.entity_id
WHERE q.id = '{{ $json.queryId }}'::uuid
